cases.name: Nancy Hanson
cases.about: Nancy was a popular and well-liked exercise instructor in the local area, according to those who knew her.
cases.narrative: He allegedly beat her to death with a baseball bat (and weighted metal bar) in front of her children two days after she filed a restraining order against him. An autopsy revealed she had fractured forearms, several fractured ribs, blunt force injuries to her skull, and a bruised torso. One of Richard and Nancy's sons called 911 and was heard screaming "stop dad, you're killing her".
